Indian troops attempt to cross Comilla border in 1971
2014-12-09T00:03:54+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/indian-troops-attempt-to-cross-comilla-border-in-1971-54515

This video report prepared by foreign media  anytime between December 3 to 5 during Liberation War in 1971 quotes West Pakistani army saying around eight to ten thousand men of Indian 57th Mountain Division crossed three miles into East Pakistan territory under heavy artillery cover.

SEE: 1971 War Calender - December 5, 1971
